title: Opening: date, place, names and corn whiskey
summary: Allen sets up the recording at Bay St. Louis, Mississippi on 11 November 1962, gets names and spellings for Harry Fairconnetue, Joe Jackson and Harold Dejan.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Real One today and what's today's day? November? November 11 or 12. What's the day? 10. No, the day is not the 10th. Sunday. Sunday 11.
Sunday 11. 1962. And where are we anyway? Besson-Lon, Mississippi. Yeah, but the exact address, because I don't know anything about that.
423 Webster Street. 423 Webster Street. Bay, St. Louis, Mississippi.
Let's get your name on here.
Harry Fairkeneutu. How do you spell it, Harry? F-A-I-R Fair, C-O-N-Con, N-E-N-E-T-U-E-T-U. Fairkeneutu.
Fairkeneutu. I'll never be able to say that. I have two T's in there. And what's your name, where we're in the corner now? We've got to get this down here.
Okay, and you? Harry Dejon. And my name is Dick Allen. So we've got to get the secretaries to hear, you know. And we're over here drinking this fine tin high. Tin high a corn whisker.
I bet the booze packed this corn for the records. Yeah. Oh yeah, the corn got to go. Yeah, well we just... Because I just broke to see you. Yeah, that's burning. Yeah.
